name: AE JSX export artifact manifest schema
compatibility_classification: Measured snapshot-to-JSX export artifact manifest contract

path_fields.generated_jsx_path: string_or_null; metadata-only pointer to a create-new artifact when output.jsx was requested
path_fields.export_report_path: string_or_null; metadata-only pointer to the report sidecar when --report was requested

summary_fields.jsx_bytes: integer byte length only; generated JSX body is not embedded

generated_jsx_artifact_digest.digest_hex: 64 lowercase hex characters over the generated JSX artifact body; body is not embedded
generated_jsx_artifact_digest.digest_scope: generated JSX artifact body; body is not embedded

summary_fields.warning_count: integer count only; warning bodies live in the report sidecar
summary_fields.private_paths_redacted_or_omitted: boolean copied from the report privacy gate

artifact_write_gate.generated_jsx_write_performed: boolean copied from the report artifact gate

binding.checksum_hex: 16 lowercase hex characters; non-cryptographic drift sentinel for metadata fields only
binding.checksum_scope: metadata-only export binding; excludes snapshot JSON and generated JSX bodies but includes the generated JSX artifact digest fields

cryptographic_digest.digest_hex: 64 lowercase hex characters; metadata-only digest over the same canonical fields as checksum_hex
cryptographic_digest.digest_scope: metadata-only export digest; excludes snapshot JSON and generated JSX bodies but includes the generated JSX artifact digest fields

notes: This manifest is a metadata-only local sidecar for reviewing generated JSX artifacts before any manual AE run.

The binding checksum and digest are metadata-only review aids, not public notarization, and do not cover the source snapshot JSON or generated JSX body directly; they do cover the generated JSX artifact digest fields.
The generated_jsx_artifact_digest records a sha256-v1 digest of the generated JSX body without embedding the body.
Current review/approval validators recalculate this metadata-only checksum and digest before accepting the manifest as review evidence.
It must not embed the source snapshot JSON body, generated JSX body, private project payloads, or binary AEP data.
The manifest records approval as required_pending and requires a receipt before AE launch, JSX execution, or project write.
The manifest is not an approval receipt and does not permit executing the generated JSX.
ae_project_edit_approval must reject this manifest kind as a request-pair approval scope; approval remains scoped to ae_project_edit_ir_jsx_request_pair manifests.
export_ae_jsx still does not write .aep/.aepx projects, overwrite source projects, launch After Effects, or execute JSX.
